rationale: After printing a session low of $28.62 (0.66% MFE), PHG has bounced into the $28.87–$28.92 resistance zone formed by the 5-minute 9-EMA and session VWAP. The most recent 1-minute bars show upward momentum stalling at $28.91 on declining volume (1,455 shares on the latest bar), keeping the bearish structure intact below VWAP and well below our $29.08 invalidation level. We hold the short position to allow the test of VWAP resistance to resolve back toward session lows.
